rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A UNIFORM REWARD SYSTEM IN THE CAMPAIGN AGAINST CRIMES AND LAWLESSNESS
rows.abstract: Rationale:  In the newspapers, on television and radio, our people read, watch and hear the ccontinuing appeals of our policy agencies to their sense of partriotism and civic pride to report crimes and criminals. In this country of relative mass unemployment and soaring prices, our people have long ago discovered that patriotism and civic pride alone cannot keep body and soul together. this bill provides the remedy - a monetary incentive, a reward, a just and reasonable compensation.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2000-03-07

rows.author: C001
rows.title_full: AN ACT ADJUSTING PENSIONS UNDER THE GOVERNMENT SERVICE INSURANCE SYSTEM TO A MINIMUM LEVEL OF EIGHT THOUSAND PESOS (P8,000.00) UNDER AN ECONOMIC ADJUSTMENT PENSION PROGRAM
rows.abstract: Any law to the contrary notwithstanding , the minimum monthly pension under the Government Service Insurance System shall be four thousand pesos (P4,000.00). Provided, that in the succeeding years starting January 2000, the monthly pension shall beincreased annually, for five years, by not less than eight hundred pesos (P800.00).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2000-03-07
